enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping under a thick blanket to stay warm during the cold snap
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull thick blanket up to chin. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket tighter. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed in warm school clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn off tap. Dry face. Take off pajamas. Put on warm shirt. Put on sweater. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a hot breakfast and preparing a packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Cook breakfast. Eat breakfast. Drink juice. Wash dishes. Open cupboard. Take out lunchbox. Prepare sandwich. Place in lunchbox. Close lunchbox. Put in bag. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing school bag, checking phone for messages and putting on a jacket
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open school bag. Place textbooks inside. Place notebooks inside. Place pencil case inside. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send reply. Close messaging app. Put phone in pocket. Pick up jacket. Put on jacket. Zip jacket. Pick up school bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to school. Enter school building.

Sit at desk. Take out textbook. Open notebook. Write notes. Listen to teacher. Raise hand. Answer question. Stand up. Walk to next class. Sit down. Take out calculator. Solve problems. Write answers. Put away materials. Stand up. Walk to lunch. Eat lunch. Return to class. Sit down. Pack bag at end of day.
Walk out of school. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating an afternoon snack and drinking something warm after the cold walk home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Take off jacket. Hang jacket. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Place snack on plate. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place kettle on stove. Turn on stove. Wait for water to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat snack. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing homework and studying at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on light. Take out homework. Open notebook. Read assignment. Pick up pencil. Write answers. Erase mistake. Rewrite. Open textbook. Read chapter. Highlight important points. Close textbook. Pick up phone. Search for information. Put phone down. Continue writing. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Continue studying.
Walk to kitchen. Set table. Place plate. Place utensils. Sit down. Serve food. Eat. Pick up fork. Lift food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and tidying the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash cup. Rinse cup. Place in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse. Place. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch, watching TV and scrolling on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Scroll.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather. Rinse. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing class notes and checking phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open notebook. Read notes. Highlight key points. Close notebook. Pick up phone. Unlock. Check messages. Reply. Open social media. Scroll. Put phone down. Pick up book. Read. Put book down. Yawn. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Return.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to side. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep.
